title: The East Park Inn~a cozy spot w/ easy walkability!
description:
Welcome to Nashville! Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located apartment. Walk to Titans games, 5 Points or jump in a quick Uber to Broadway. This cozy 1 bedroom apartment has its own private entrance and bathroom and no steps to climb. A nice queen sized bed with soft linens. Plenty of yummy restaurants within a stones throw as well as a couple arcades & breweries. There's even The Basement East just 2 blocks away, to go see a live show. Guest house is non smoking inside #2022057108

The space
The space is an open studio with a kitchenette and a big bathroom.

Guest access
Guests have access to the parking spot in the back of the house and the area that’s inside the fence around the apartment.

Other things to note
We do have a couple of pups that will occasionally be on the other side of the privacy fence. The gate to our backyard will be locked so they will not have access to your enclosed area. Their names are Chester (10) & Mimosa (2)

Also our neighbor has a 2 bedroom apartment to rent as well. So if you have a larger group you can rent both and be very close to one another https://www.airbnb.com/h/staywiththegibsons
